title: Properness of representable stack maps is tested on an fppf target cover
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with universes [def-weil-size-convention]. An algebraic stack means a stack in groupoids with diagonal representable by algebraic spaces and a smooth surjective scheme atlas; stack, representability and 2-fibre products use [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids], algebraic spaces use [def-trf-algebraic-space], and smoothness uses [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] on scheme charts. Let $f:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ be a morphism of algebraic stacks representable by algebraic spaces. Let $W$ be a scheme and $p:W\to\mathcal Y$ a representable surjective flat locally finitely presented morphism. Surjectivity means surjectivity on point spaces after scheme base change, and flatness and local finite presentation are tested on etale scheme charts using [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Put $V=\mathcal X\times_{\mathcal Y}W$. Then $f$ is proper if and only if $V\to W$ is proper. Proper for a representable stack map means that every scheme base change $\mathcal X\times_{\mathcal Y}T\to T$ is a proper morphism of algebraic spaces, and similarly for $V\to W$. A morphism of algebraic spaces is proper when it is separated (its diagonal is a closed immersion after every scheme base change [def-weil-closed-immersion]), of finite type (quasi-compact, and locally of finite type on etale scheme charts [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]) and universally closed (closed on point spaces after every algebraic-space base change); for morphisms of schemes this is properness as in [def-weil-proper-morphism].

source.place: Tag 04XD, lemma-check-property-covering, for P = proper in Section 04XB; arbitrary scheme base S.

proof.text: If $f$ is proper, its defining scheme test at $p:W\to\mathcal Y$ says that $V\to W$ is proper as an algebraic-space map. Every further scheme base change of this map is proper by [lem-sfb-space-proper-base-change]. Thus it also satisfies the scheme-test interpretation of properness for $V\to W$ in the statement.

source.place: Tag 04XD, lemma-check-property-covering, proof specialized to properness and a scheme cover W.

proof.text: Conversely suppose $V\to W$ is proper, and fix an arbitrary scheme map $t:T\to\mathcal Y$. Put $A=\mathcal X\times_{\mathcal Y}T$ and $B=W\times_{\mathcal Y}T$. Both are algebraic spaces by the representability hypotheses on $f$ and $p$. By [def-trf-algebraic-space], choose a representable surjective etale scheme atlas $a:U\to B$. Write $q:B\to T$, $h=q a:U\to T$ and $w:U\to W$ for the projections. The map to $B$ supplies an isomorphism $\beta:p(w)\xrightarrow{\sim}t(h)$. All choices are in the stipulated universes.

source.place: Tag 04XD, lemma-check-property-covering, proof specialized to properness and a scheme cover W.

proof.text: The scheme test of the hypotheses on $p$ at $T$ makes $q$ surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation. The atlas $a$ is etale and surjective also as a representable map of fibred groupoids by [lem-sfb-fibred-groupoid-representable-smooth-calculus]. By [lem-sfb-stack-chartwise-smooth-etale-calculus], etale implies smooth, hence flat and locally of finite presentation; these properties and surjectivity are preserved by composition. Consequently the scheme map $h:U\to T$ is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation. By [def-pc-fppf-site], $\{h\}$ is an fppf scheme covering of $T$. In particular no quasi-compactness of $p$, $B$ or $U$ was assumed.

source.place: Tag 04XD, lemma-check-property-covering, proof specialized to properness and a scheme cover W.

proof.text: There is an isomorphism over $U$, $A\times_TU\simeq V\times_WU$. Indeed, on a test scheme $D$, an object of the left side can be written $(x,u,\alpha:f(x)\xrightarrow{\sim}t(h(u)))$. Send it to $(x,w(u),\beta(u)^{-1}\alpha,u)$ on the right. The inverse composes the isomorphism $f(x)\to p(w(u))$ with $\beta(u)$. These operations are inverse on objects and on compatible arrows, commute with pullback in $D$, and preserve $u$. This is precisely the 2-fibre-product definition in [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Both sides are spaces: their sheaf fibre products exist by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]; their associated discrete fibred groupoids therefore give an isomorphism of spaces, not just a bijection on field points.

source.place: Tag 04XD, lemma-check-property-covering, proof specialized to properness and a scheme cover W.

proof.text: The right side of step 4 is the algebraic-space base change of the proper map $V\to W$ along $w:U\to W$, so its projection to $U$ is proper by [lem-sfb-space-proper-base-change]. Use step 4 to identify it with $A\times_TU\to U$. Properness is unchanged by this identification: the diagonals correspond, chartwise finite type and quasi-compactness correspond under isomorphism, and the point maps after every base change are conjugate by homeomorphisms. Apply the properness clause of [lem-sfb-space-flat-proper-fp-locality] to $A\to T$ and the singleton fppf covering $\{U\to T\}$ of step 3. It gives properness of $A\to T$. Since $T\to\mathcal Y$ was arbitrary, this is exactly the definition of properness of $f$.

The statement, stmt_deps and blueprint fields are unchanged from the base. The item is still unsplit in live and side-live, and there is no repair note. The proof follows Stacks 04XD (stacks-properties.tex l.466, after lemma-property-spaces-too). The source writes the fppf cover as {T×_𝒴 V → T}, which is a typo for T×_𝒴 W → T. The delivery uses T×_𝒴 W and refines it by an étale scheme atlas to a singleton fppf scheme cover {h: U→T}, which is correct and needed because lem-sfb-space-flat-proper-fp-locality descends along fppf scheme covers. Steps: (1) the forward direction is the definition at T=W plus lem-sfb-space-proper-base-change. (2) A and B are spaces by the two representability hypotheses, and the atlas comes from def-trf-algebraic-space. (3) h is surjective, flat and lfp by the chart bridge of lem-sfb-fibred-groupoid-representable-smooth-calculus and the composition and étale⇒smooth⇒flat+lfp clauses of lem-sfb-stack-chartwise-smooth-etale-calculus; no quasi-compactness is used. (4) The explicit triple isomorphism A×_T U ≃ V×_W U via β(u)⁻¹α has the right orientation. (5) Base change along w, transport across the isomorphism, then the properness clause of lem-sfb-space-flat-proper-fp-locality (each property separate, so flatness of A is not needed). Edge cases checked: empty T, empty 𝒳, nonempty 𝒴 forcing nonempty W, and automorphisms kept in β. I searched the DAG for duplicates: the existing 04XD nodes cover affine, finite type, quasi-finite and separated over a field; flat, lfp, étale and open immersion; unramified; or scheme-representable maps. None states properness for maps representable by algebraic spaces over an arbitrary S. The item's closure is acyclic and proof_deps equals the union of step uses. The tool use lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers (generic fibre products of spaces) is accepted. The trf fibre-product lemma is a generic fact about algebraic spaces, not a step of the trace formula or of Poincaré duality. All five are outside the assumed statements. No SGA source is used.
